STAGE 1 · PREPARE BOARD ONCE & SEED LEVEL-2 QUEUE
2. SIMD Prep — Normalize & Split 5-Bit Letters (16 Lanes)

g.text: + lanes @3, @4, @6..@14 · computed once per board and kept in XMM registers

svg.text: STAGE 2 · PHASE A — TRIE LOOKUP, SSSE3 PROJECTION & 16-BIT GRID FILTER
4. Trie Node #45 & SSSE3 Projection (All 16 Board Cells)

g.text: Broadcast 4-byte child_mask → route per board cell via vpshufb
AND bit_sel (isolate each cell's single alphabet bit)

svg.text: 5. 16-Bit Grid Filter (3 Masks Combined via Bitwise AND)
STAGE 3 · PHASE B — TWO-SLOT BIT SCAN, COMPACTION & ZERO-COPY OUTPUT
6. Phase B: Two-Slot Bit Scan (Unrolled ×2) & Multi-Pass Compact

g.text: k2 = k1 & (k1 − 1) · paths with 3+ matches pack in-place for the next pass
Level-3 paths · repeat Stages 2–3 until level_size == 0
